source.title: Teacher, peer, or AI? Comparing effects of feedback sources in higher education
source.basis: Values transcribed from Results sections 4.1 and 4.2, pages 8-9; not digitized from figures and not re-estimated.

scope: Focused Teacher-LLM comparison. Peer is omitted from the display, not from the original statistical analyses. Summary estimates are not individual observations or change scores.

panels.interval_type: Mean plus/minus one reported standard error

panels.estimate_type: Estimated marginal mean, adjusted for initial submission quality
